info.name: IGDB API
info.description:
All endpoints from the IGDB API as outlined in the [documentation](https://api-docs.igdb.com/?javascript#endpoints). ## Getting started - Fork this collection on your own account - Select the pinned `IGDB` environment - Copy your Twitch client ID and secret to the `twitch_client_id` and `twitch_client_secret` environment variables, respectively; if you don't have credentials, you can obtain them by [registering an application](https://dev.twitch.tv/console/apps/create) - [Get an access token](https://www.postman.com/aceprosports/workspace/public/request/18853756-e073c768-7649-4baf-9dcb-d4e747a8556d) and copy it to the `twitch_access_token` environment variable _Ensure you set the_ _**current value**_ _for all environment variables._
You should now be able to access all the endpoints!

request.description: Be sure to copy your access token from the response body to the `twitch_access_token` environment variable in order to successfully access all the endpoints.
